summary: Placement today HAS a working corridor-eviction lever (cec_place.apply_corridor_evict carries the part + its passive cluster; cec_router.corridor_evict_repair is the cluster-blind/fence-blind manager analogue; cec_synth_pipeline.corridor_violations is the deterministic detector) but it is EI-BLIND: it fires unconditionally in the offline cec_place.refine() loop (never inside the per-round A/B loop), emits no lane field / corpus_state pin / measurement row / ledger decision, is not model-proposable (absent from OWNED_LEVERS), and the cec_fs_actuator 'replace' Delta that the auditor/v4-escape produce is INERT (intent=None at finding_to_delta:108-109 and v4_structural_escape:175, with no consumer anywhere). The EI gap vs routing: the six EI points (EI-01 corpus_state, EI-02 lane-gated A/B, EI-03/05 shadow aggregate + budget, EI-06 symmetric DeltaLog promotion/rollback, EI-07 real_anchor_ratio) and the full Delta lifecycle (live->apply->measure->settle->rollback, fenced+bounded) all apply to routing every round but NOT to placement. Fully effectuating placement as an actuating tier with parity requires: (1) populate the replace intent so it is live; (2) consume it by editing the COMMITTED floorplan into a per-round override COPY (placed-r{N}.kicad_pcb) that the NEXT route_directed compiles from via a host-carried placement_base, augmented-only, with the control lane reading the committed board (signed-only); (3) settle it through the existing kind-opaque DeltaLog with two-phase override promotion (vindicated only) + rollback; (4) re-measure pour integrity on the moved+routed board so a move can't launder gates; (5) tag the existing measurement row + A/B table; (6) credit it as a deterministic anchor; plus the cross-cutting safety: a double fence wall (host + in-container after a NET resolves to a concrete body), a cluster-aware fence-aware manager tier, deduped band-edge math, sorted/fresh-subprocess determinism. The work is additive and opt-in (no replace finding -> placement_base stays None -> every round routes the committed board exactly as today), so SB-08 and the existing EI-02/actuator tests stay green.

invariants: No gate-launder: a placement move is RE-MEASURED for the kelvin/diffpair/DRC AND pour-integrity gates on the moved+routed board (via _remeasure_pour_gate discipline); placement_base PROMOTES only on a vindicated, gate-passing settle -- a move that fragments a sense pour or strands a Kelvin tap is gate-failed and cannot be adopted.

Control lane stays signed-only: a control round MUST route from the committed BOARD_PCB[board] floorplan, never the placement override (_placement_source_for('control',...) returns the committed board unconditionally); the row shows placement_moved=False / placement_verdict='suppressed' on control. A leak makes the A/B baseline non-signed.

Fence holds across BOTH walls: a placement move may NEVER target a pinned ref (BOARD_PINNED_REFS: RS*/U2/INA sense ICs), a /SENSEC*_HI|_LO Kelvin/sense net, or a corridor shunt RS*/connector J* as the eviction target -- checked host-side in finding_to_delta (line 102, already covers replace) AND re-checked in-container after corridor_violations resolves a NET target to a concrete body, AND at the lever (apply_corridor_evict fence param).

Cluster integrity (the MEDIUM): a moved sensitive body carries its owned decoupling/passive cluster (C*/R* within 4mm on a shared net) and NEVER drags a structural shunt RS* or connector J*; the manager-tier place_cluster path matches apply_corridor_evict, never the old cap-blind place_nudge.

Two-phase rollback / no ratchet: placement_base PROMOTES to the override path ONLY on 'vindicated'; a refuted/overturned/control-suppressed move reverts placement_base to None/last-vindicated, drops the override, and a refuted hypothesis_key is not re-proposed (mirrors the avoid-delta carry rollback at 1891-1900).

The committed floorplan is never mutated by the loop: placement edits a per-round COPY (build/fullstack/placed-r{N}.kicad_pcb), exactly as refine() copies before editing and route_directed compiles into a workdir; BOARD_PCB[board] on disk is read-only to the loop.

Determinism: cluster + moved_refs sorted by ref; the override write + eviction geometry (corridor_violations + nearest_evict_delta) reproducible; a fresh in-container pcbnew LoadBoard per apply, Save, then del board -- never reuse a swig object after Save (the four pcbnew SWIG footguns); any serialized fence emitted as sorted lists.

Bound holds: placement 'replace' deltas share MAX_DELTAS_PER_ROUND with avoid/effort deltas through the ONE select_deltas call (replace is already in the actionable list); placement cannot get a separate budget.

Additive / opt-in: when no replace delta fires, placement_base stays None and every round routes from the committed floorplan exactly as today; real_anchor_ratio's placement_moved defaults False -> a non-placement round (and SB-08) is byte-identical. SB-08 golden + the existing EI-02/actuator host tests stay green.
open_questions: A/B SCOPE: is placement A/B fullstack-loop-scoped (the recommended path here -- apply_placement_move runs inside the per-round loop, lane-gated, settled through DeltaLog, control routes the committed board) OR is placement A/B explicitly DOCUMENTED as cec_loop-scoped (the offline refine() path stays the only consumer and the fullstack lever is deferred)? The grounding names BOTH as acceptable remediations ('wire the replace Delta ... OR explicitly document placement A/B as cec_loop-scoped'). All four panels assume fullstack-scoped; the owner must ratify that the per-round-override architecture (re-route the moved floorplan every augmented round) is the intended design rather than carrying a moved board across rounds.

real_anchor_ratio MEANING when a part moves: all panels agree the APPLIED eviction is a DETERMINISTIC anchor (det+=1) because the band+body come from corridor_violations (a deterministic §2.2 checker) and the eviction math is reproducible, while the auditor PROPOSAL that triggered it is a separate model anchor already counted via audit/verifier. The owner should confirm this grounding direction (placement RAISES the deterministic fraction, never the model fraction) and that a SUPPRESSED/fenced/no-move round does NOT increment det -- i.e. only an actually-applied move counts, not a proposed-but-refused one.

OWNED_LEVERS wording vs _lever_kind ordering: _lever_kind checks 'corridor'->avoid BEFORE 'place'->replace, so a clause containing the bare word 'corridor' would mis-classify the placement lever to the routing/avoid branch. Decide: word the OWNED_LEVERS placement clause WITHOUT 'corridor' (e.g. 'PLACEMENT EVICTION ... foreign pour band'), OR reorder _lever_kind so explicit place/move/reposition wins over the corridor keyword. (Recommended: the wording fix -- lower blast radius -- but the owner picks which, and the round-trip test pins it.)

Override carry across rounds: the design keeps placement single-round (re-route the moved floorplan fresh each augmented round, placement_base just selects which floorplan that round compiles from). Confirm a vindicated move's override should persist as the new placement_base for SUBSEQUENT augmented rounds (so a good move compounds) vs being re-derived from scratch each round -- the two-phase promotion in PL-06 assumes it persists until overturned; the owner should ratify that compounding behavior and the control-round revert semantics.
